title: Algorithmic Fairness
description: A focused, compact advanced path on fairness in ML systems: reading disaggregated metrics to diagnose disparate impact, comparing demographic parity against equalized odds, and tracing the root cause of a fairness failure to the right model component.
outcomes: You'll interpret disaggregated classification metrics to surface fairness gaps, distinguish demographic parity from equalized odds, and diagnose the root cause of disparate impact in a production model.
